description.p: Prelora helps you capture, clarify, and finish work on your own machine. It combines a GTD-style task hub with live countdown timers in one calm desktop app — local-first, with encrypted data at rest. Everyday GTD is included free forever.
Included free forever: GTD lists, unlimited timers, and unlimited calendar reminders.

ul.li: Inbox, Next, Scheduled, Someday, and Focus lists (unlimited tasks)
Search across lists, recurring tasks, and Trash with restore
Unlimited live countdown timers at any start duration
Stock snooze chips: 5 minutes, 30 minutes, and 1 hour
Unlimited month-grid reminders with repeating schedules
Encryption, backup, export, iCal, and attachments on device

description.p: Optional Pro extras are not included free forever.

ul.li: Pro: up to four custom snooze chips, plus a type-any add-time field on running timers
Pro: extra alert sounds beyond the bundled chime
Pro: Kanban board when that view ships in a release (not included free forever)

description.p: Optional Pro extras are sold separately on https://prelora.app/ (terms: https://prelora.app/terms/). Unlock with a voucher in Settings.
